description: Look up the WEO methodology definition for any platform-specific term, field, or concept (e.g. "CC-V", "T2", "PAA", "ENT-1", "PIET"). Returns the term's definition, its section anchor, a deep link to that section of the published methodology, and the methodology version. Use to resolve any vocabulary the other tools return. Pass `term`; matching is exact-first, then substring, and an unknown term returns a sample of available terms.

term.description: The term to look up (e.g., "CC-V", "T2", "PAA", "ENT-1", "PIET", "Basel Assessment")

name: get_methodology
title: Get Methodology Definition
